quote: The driver of a vehicle within a business or residence district emerging or entering an alley, driveway or building shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway or driveway, yielding the right-of-way to any pedestrian as may be necessary to avoid collision, and upon entering the roadway shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on said roadway.

activation.condition: driver of a vehicle within a business or residence district emerging or entering an alley, driveway or building

obligation.description: stop immediately before the sidewalk area; yield to pedestrians when necessary to avoid collision; upon roadway entry yield to approaching vehicles

timing.description: ordered sidewalk stop, pedestrian yield, and conditional roadway entry yield

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: immediately prior to driving onto a sidewalk
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain stopping interval and the first sidewalk-footprint contact; no legal distance or duration cutoff is supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: as may be necessary to avoid collision
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain pedestrian and vehicle trajectories and relative spacing; do not turn a conflict proxy into legal necessity.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: all vehicles approaching on said roadway
judgment_calls_needed.note: This duty is conditional on entering the roadway and cannot be realized by this road-exit-only cell.
